Resources & advice

Documents & diagrams

Read the Yinyang method, follow practical guides for learning, creation, and your environment, or explore ideas and diagrams. Philosophy also has its own connected reading route.

Yinyang: explanation and methods

These four materials concern one practice, addressing readers who want to understand the whole and models carrying collaboration, modeling and writing, or environmental implementation.

  • The practice as a whole

    For readers: explains how philosophy, understanding the person and counterpart, and the working environment connect.

  • Model entrypoint

    For the model: specifies how to read and use these materials in ordinary collaboration.

  • Formation and revision

    For the model doing modeling and writing: develops and revises understanding of the person, counterpart, and their relationship.

  • Harness adaptation

    For the model doing implementation: realizes this understanding through instructions, tools, and ways of working, then revises through actual results.

References for the five accounts

These public writing guides explain what each account concerns. You and the model form the actual person, counterpart, relationship, and provenance accounts from your own material in a private version; these are not someone else’s personal accounts.

  • Encounter

    Condense purpose, participation, and the relationship into a usable view for ordinary work.

  • User model

    Understand the actual person, retaining relevant differences, scope, and uncertainty.

  • Counterpart and relationship

    Develop counterpart contributions, cooperation, independent judgment, and reciprocal correction.

  • Situated use

    Connect the relationship to the actual environment, resources, and allocation of work.

  • Sources

    Locate evidence and its owners, following authorized routes to original material.

Views and reading

Consult Yinyang’s claims, arguments, and sources. Philosophical, psychological, and engineering readings connect while retaining their own questions.

  • Core views

    Find the main claims together, organized by topic.

  • Read by the work being done

    Find relevant arguments, methods, and original sources from the question at hand.

  • Philosophical readings

    Trace thinkers and works to their role in the argument and their original sources.

  • Psychological readings

    Books and papers on psychological process modeling and evidence, mind and psychological theories, belief, reasoning, and interaction.

  • Engineering readings

    From CS DIY and Missing Semester to Git, Linux, software design, algorithms, experimental implementation, and physical conditions.

Skills

Learning and research

Find evidence, prepare reading material, and connect learning with practice.

  • 搜索与研究 · research

    Investigate facts, product behavior, and alternatives with inspectable sources, observations, assumptions, and coverage limits.

  • 任务探究 · task-inquiry

    Clarify consequential uncertainty through real tensions, evidence, reasoning, and useful questions.

  • 论文与学术书籍检索 · paper-retrieval

    Reconcile bibliography, editions, and full text to deliver verifiable scholarly material.

  • 本地老师 · local-teacher

    Explain, review, and practice in a local environment, developing understanding through real work.

  • 云端老师 · web-teacher

    Provide shared methods for course material, teaching, learning paths, and learning spaces.

  • 购物与比价 · shopping

    Compare products, prices, offers, and secondhand choices with inspectable evidence and conditions.

Authoring and collaboration

Write and maintain instructions, organize collaboration, continue model conversations, or make a random selection.

  • 提示词与技能生命周期 · prompt-and-skill-lifecycle

    Connect instruction meaning, ownership, delivery, and evidence of use when authoring, auditing, and maintaining Prompts and Skills.

  • 提示词审计 · prompt-audit-orchestration

    Audit instructions and execution relationships across learning, work, Web, and automation within the requested scope.

  • 多智能体协作 · agent-orchestration-master

    Organize contributions, handoffs, and dependencies around actual work, with the task owner integrating results.

  • 模型对话接续 · model-conversation-relay

    Continue an already bound ChatGPT advisory conversation: inspect, wait, or submit an exact authorized request, retaining the original response and transport receipt.

  • 抽卡转盘 · random-wheel

    Turn screenshot choices or named options into a speed-adjustable animated wheel with equal-probability random selection.

Devices and environments

Make devices, browsers, notes, configuration, and networks support actual work.

  • 个人环境设计 · personal-environment-design

    Organize websites, desktops, and cross-tool work around human understanding and action.

  • 安卓手机控制 · android-control

    Operate your Android device through ADB and native interfaces, verifying actual effects.

  • 浏览器会话 · browser-relay

    Manage task-owned browsers, authenticated sessions, target ownership, and cleanup.

  • 笔记同步 · obsidian-sync

    Maintain shared configuration, cloud copies, and synchronization across Obsidian vaults.

  • 系统配置持久化 · chezmoi

    Persist authorized host configuration changes in source and converge them through the actual publication mechanism.

  • 网络诊断 · network

    Diagnose DNS, proxies, website connectivity, and routing from host evidence.

  • 节点自动切换 · clash-auto-switch

    Maintain Clash node selection, regional fallback, and DNS/TUN protection.

  • 模型升级检查 · model-upgrade-check

    Reconcile available models, purpose-specific selections, and actual consumers.

  • 视频字幕提取 · video-subtitle
